wire.phone_access.title.note: 'Phone access' is the product feature letting the mobile app reach this computer through a Radient tunnel.

wire.phone_access.description.note: Radient is a product name and stays verbatim.

wire.phone_access.auto_setup.help.note: The safety meaning must survive translation: the background run NEVER activates billing or spends credit.

wire.phone_access.away_after.label.tone: Plain sentence fragment completed by the chosen duration
wire.phone_access.away_after.label.note: ADR 0008 desk presence. The row's value (1/2/5/10 minutes) is rendered after this label, so it ends with 'for'. 'Away' means no keyboard or mouse input, or the screen locked.

wire.phone_access.away_after.help.tone: Plain, two or three short sentences
wire.phone_access.away_after.help.note: Explain that idle time (no keyboard/mouse input) decides when a finished task goes to the phone instead of the desktop; locking the screen counts as away immediately; it needs the desktop app, which measures the idle time.

wire.phone_access.away_after.choice.1m.l.note: 1 minute(s). Follows the label 'Send to phone when I'm away from my computer for'; use the grammatical case that reads naturally after that label.
